adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed rework completed for doi__10.3390_v11111011. The primary paper supports Vero CC50, ZIKV/JEV IC50, C6/36 non-cytotoxicity and ZIKV titer reduction, and a prM-cleavage/virus-release mechanism. Database rows that mix other papers or unsupported host-cell/mechanism wording are preserved as cautions rather than converted to clean source verification.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DBAASP/DRAMP JEV rows refer to BHK-21 cells, while the paper describes Vero infection with BHK-21 used for JEV plaque titration.
DRAMP/CAMP rows include HBV or SARS-CoV-2 claims from other references; these are not promoted as claims for this DOI.
A DBAASP C6/36 row says not active up to 100 µM, but local source supports no C6/36 cytotoxicity through 100 µM and ZIKV titer reduction at 100 µM.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Four source-supported activity rows were reconciled against the primary paper, while twelve database rows remain source_conflict and one CAMP row remains database_only_no_primary_source because they include non-current-paper claims or unsupported wording.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Five activity/toxicity/effect records were recovered from source text and figure captions with endpoint, raw value, unit, target, conditions, and locators.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: The final mechanism layer is limited to source-supported prM-cleavage inhibition, dose-dependent antiviral effect, and virus release/next-round infectivity; automated membrane/nucleic-acid/protein-synthesis notes were rejected.

semantic_quality_checks.source_exhaustion: XML, PDF text, figure captions, OA package inventory, supplementary index/archive manifest, and linked database snapshots checked.

summary: Source-reviewed worker-2/4/6 rework recovered supported activity rows and preserved database conflicts as cautions for dec-RVKR-cmk in ZIKV/JEV/C6/36 assays.
